import importlib.util, json, pathlib, re, sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
month = pathlib.Path("/home/kaalin/dev/wamn/docs/perf/2026.09")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("nested_compare", month / "ctc8-16-http-reuse/tools/compare-workspace.py")
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
reducer, causes = module.load_helpers()
evidence = month / "ctc8-33-nested-authority/integrated-workspace-001"
current = json.loads((evidence / "workspace-results.json").read_text())
comparison = json.loads((evidence / "workspace-comparison.json").read_text())
old_name = "trusted_http_route::tests::nested_http_keeps_original_caller_and_refuses_unproven_child_authority"
new_name = "trusted_http_route::tests::nested_http_authorizes_child_and_preserves_original_caller"
wit = ["wamn-proof-conformance", "--lib", "version_identity::wamn_wit_packages_stay_at_mvp_version"]
extra = ["route_authentication_live::overlay_compatibility::installed_contract_observer_preserves_acls_and_refuses_changed_requirements", "route_authentication_live::postcommit::production_materializer_preserves_replay_and_progress"]
scratch = ["wamn-proof-conformance", "--test workspace_tiers", "workspace_tier_helper_runs_safely_outside_repository"]
references = {"pooling": month / "ctc8-16-http-reuse/integrated-workspace-001/workspace-results.json", "receiving": month / "receiving-postcommit/integrated-workspace-001/workspace-results.json"}
def failure(receipt, name):
    [row] = [row for row in receipt["failures"] if row["name"] == name]
    return row
rows = {}
for label, path in references.items():
    reference = json.loads(path.read_text())
    part = comparison["comparisons"][label]
    assert all(not part[key] for key in ["duplicate_failure_identities", "reference_unresolved", "current_unresolved", "added_explicit_self_skips", "absent_explicit_self_skips", "added_targets", "absent_reference_targets"])
    [changed] = part["changed_causes"]
    assert changed["identity"] == wit
    before, after = changed["before"], changed["after"]
    normalize = lambda value: re.sub(r"/home/kaalin/\.cache/wamn-lanes/[^/]+/", "<source-tree>/", json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True))
    assert normalize(before) == normalize(after)
    assert causes.cause(failure(reference, old_name), reducer) == causes.cause(failure(current, new_name), reducer)
    expected_added = [new_name] + (extra if label == "pooling" else [])
    assert sorted(row["identity"][2] for row in part["added_failures"]) == sorted(expected_added)
    expected_absent = [["wamn-proof-integration", "--lib", old_name]] + ([scratch] if label == "receiving" else [])
    assert sorted(part["absent_reference_failures"]) == sorted(expected_absent)
    rows[label] = {"exact_identity_and_cause_matches": len(part["exact_identity_and_cause_matches"]), "checkout_path_only_difference": wit, "renamed_test_same_fixture_refusal": {"before": old_name, "after": new_name}, "other_added_failures": extra if label == "pooling" else [], "other_absent_failures": [scratch] if label == "receiving" else []}
receiving = json.loads(references["receiving"].read_text())
for name in extra:
    assert causes.cause(failure(receiving, name), reducer) == causes.cause(failure(current, name), reducer)
log = (evidence / "workspace.log").read_text()
assert len(re.findall(r"^test workspace_tier_helper_runs_safely_outside_repository \.\.\. ok$", log, re.M)) == 1
stability = json.loads((evidence / "source-stability.json").read_text())
assert stability == {"same_commit": True, "clean_before_and_after": True}
assert current["counts"]["test_failed"] == 83 and not current["unresolved"]
inputs = [evidence / "workspace-results.json", evidence / "workspace-comparison.json", evidence / "source-stability.json", *references.values(), month / "receiving-postcommit/workspace-tempdir-rerun-001/classification.json"]
print(json.dumps({"schema": "wamn-nested-workspace-interpretation/v1", "source": comparison["source"], "workspace_exit_code": current["exit_code"], "counts": current["counts"], "comparisons": rows, "receiving_additions_match_the_receiving_run": True, "outside_repository_test_passed_in_this_run": True, "unresolved_classifications": [], "full_workspace_green": False, "inputs": [reducer.file_receipt(path) for path in inputs]}, indent=2))
